title: MistyRadio mc
description:
MistyRadio allows you to listen to MistyRadio directly in Minecraft without switching windows.

Start the radio using the /mistyradio command, adjust the volume to your preference
body:
MistyRadio Mod

Listen to MistyRadio directly from Minecraft — no browser, no alt-tabbing, just music while you play.

⸻

What does this mod do?

MistyRadio Mod streams the live MistyRadio broadcast directly into your Minecraft client. Everything can be controlled through simple commands or the integrated Mod Menu settings screen. Your preferences are saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off every time you start Minecraft.

⸻

Features

🎵 Live Radio Streaming

Start the radio with /mistyradio and the stream begins playing instantly. The radio automatically stops when you leave the game.

🎚️ Volume Control

Adjust the volume with /mistyradio volume <0-100>. Your volume preference is saved and automatically restored the next time you launch Minecraft.

📻 Now Playing

Want to know what’s currently on air? Use /mistyradio nowplaying to view the current song title and artist, updated directly from the MistyRadio servers.

🎧 Live DJ Notifications

Whenever a DJ goes live on MistyRadio, you’ll receive an automatic chat notification. You’ll also be notified when the DJ goes offline. Don’t want these notifications? Toggle them with /mistyradio djnotify.

🔔 Track Notifications

Receive a chat notification whenever a new song starts playing. Toggle this feature on or off with /mistyradio notify.

⚙️ Mod Menu Integration

If you have Mod Menu installed, you can configure volume, track notifications, and DJ notifications through a clean settings screen without using commands.

⸻

Commands

Command	Description
/mistyradio	Toggle the radio on or off
/mistyradio start	Start the radio
/mistyradio stop	Stop the radio
/mistyradio nowplaying	Show the current song or live DJ
/mistyradio volume <0-100>	Adjust the volume
/mistyradio notify	Toggle track notifications
/mistyradio djnotify	Toggle live DJ notifications
/mistyradio help	Show all available commands

⸻

Requirements

Component	Requirement
Minecraft	1.21.x
Mod Loader	Fabric
Fabric API	Required
Cloth Config	Required (included)
Mod Menu	Optional (for settings screen)

⸻

About MistyRadio

MistyRadio is an independent online radio station featuring a mix of music and live DJ shows. Visit https://mistyradio.org for more information
